primary_field_decisions: First distinguish actual Asteraceae capitula from the whole flower cluster: one small head contains multiple disk florets.
Opposite mature middle-stem leaves: deeply lobed = Conoclinium dissectum; toothed but undissected = Conoclinium coelestinum, pending genus confirmation.
Shrubby evergreen woody stems vs nonpersistent herbaceous stems: Ageratina havanensis vs A. altissima.
Under magnification: FNA A. havanensis cypselae hispid, A. altissima glabrous.
Single side-view capitulum: Chromolaena odorata cylindrical involucral body around 8–10 mm with 4–6(–8) phyllary series, unlike shorter hemispheric Conoclinium.
Photo of an inflorescence alone cannot show phyllary series or scale; side-on single-head macros are mandatory.
